# Draft:Cultural heritage of South Africa

South Africa once earned itself the name the "rainbow nation" because of its diversity.
Cultural heritage of South Africa ostensibly concerns itself with the variety of
heritage objects and cultural goods of cultural significance among the language and cultural groups in South Africa. Some national heritage sites in South Africa are also World Heritage Sites. These include the
*Fossil Hominid Sites of South Africa - where the species Australopithecus africanus was discovered
* Human Rights, Liberation and Reconciliation Nelson Mandela Legacy sites
